content.title: Trump ACA Plan Delayed, But Centene, Oscar Stocks Point To Passage
content.summary: President Trump's support for a two-year extension of expiring Affordable Care Act health insurance subsidies fueled a rally for Centene and Oscar Health on Monday before it ran into a wall of GOP opposition.  Shares of the two health insurers that provide coverage on the ACA Marketplaces are holding their gains on Tuesday.  The enhanced ACA subsidies that were originally passed in 2021 to make coverage more affordable are set to expire at year end, resulting in a massive increase in premiums for more than 20 million customers.
